## Topics

- Defining custom functions: function(args) { body }
- Argument defaults, return values, and lexical scoping rules
- Defensive programming: stopifnot() and custom error messages
- Functional iteration with purrr: map(), map_dbl(), and list_rbind() (formerly map_dfr())
- Comparing for loops vs purrr::map
